integrity: The universal logarithmic coefficient and remainder order are proved analytically from the exact Gaussian replica determinant. Finite calculations only corroborate the algebra and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite \(N\), integer replica order \(n\ge3\), nonempty tripartitions, and the real fully symmetric pure Gaussian family. No analytic continuation to noninteger \(n\), no general nonsymmetric-state theorem, and no arbitrary finite-\(a\) closed form are claimed.
title: Replica-nullity proof of the fully symmetric Gaussian multi-entropy asymptotic
